g.text: The FILE view you start in: tree on the left, bytes
on the right. The REGION LIST (l): the same regions as a table you
can act on in bulk. A DESCENDED view (enter, from the list): one
region opened as though it were a file of its own, so its offsets
start again at zero -- u comes back out.
lowercase looks, SHIFT works on regions.
all, X extracts what is marked, E extracts everything -- spelled the
same in the tree and in the list. The list's own tools are capitals
for the same reason (M mode, T lens, G shape, C carve): no letter
should mean one thing here and another there. One used to be worse
than confusing -- `s` was the shape column in the list and STRIP
pan the tree sideways when a deep branch runs
jump to a node's parent / to the next branch
page the hex view through the file; up/down on
the focused hex pane move it a row
move focus between the tree and the hex pane
give the focused pane the whole screen (again to
